sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: ExBLAS 思維：歸約順序與可重現總和
related.titleEn: ExBLAS principles: reduction order and reproducible sums
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付精度分工、兩組修正鏈與停滯診斷；兩δ值相符且更新解滿足原方程；報告明列精確紙面近似；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver precision roles, both refinement chains, and a stagnation diagnosis. Both corrections must match and satisfy the original equation. Identify the exact-arithmetic assumption. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫左結合與先相消兩棵樹，另列精確整數參考；不要把整數AST驗算當FP64模擬；精確1/2參考成立，浮點實驗另記型別、順序與誤差，不混稱精確。
related.differenceEn: Draw left-associated and cancellation-first trees. The cancellation-first arithmetic checks provide references; they do not simulate every FP64 operation. Exact references 1 and 2 must match. Record type, order, and error separately for floating-point experiments.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 對Ax=b，r=b−Ax、解Aδ=r再更新x+δ；殘差計算精度與修正精度需分欄；合成A3、b1，初值x=.3；另一初值.32，修正方程先以精確紙面算；名義式 (1-3*.3)/3 = 0.0333333333333 correction delta；變更式 (1-3*.32)/3 = 0.0133333333333 correction delta。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

真實數加法可結合，但有限精度每次加法會捨入；測試應保留輸入順序與精確參考；合成十進位整數[10^16,1,−10^16]，精確總和1；變更中間值2後精確總和2；名義式 (10**16-10**16)+1 = 1 exact integer reference sum；變更式 (10**16-10**16)+2 = 2 exact integer reference sum。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For Ax = b, form r = b − Ax, solve Aδ = r, and update x + δ. Record residual and correction precisions separately. Synthetic A = 3, b = 1, initial x = 0.3 versus 0.32. Solve the correction exactly on paper. Nominal (1-3*.3)/3 = 0.0333333333333 correction delta; changed (1-3*.32)/3 = 0.0133333333333 correction delta. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Real addition is associative, but finite-precision operations round each step. Retain input order and an independent exact reference. Synthetic integers [10^16, 1, −10^16] sum exactly to 1. Changing the middle value to 2 gives an exact sum of 2. Nominal (10**16-10**16)+1 = 1 exact integer reference sum; changed (10**16-10**16)+2 = 2 exact integer reference sum. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 弱擴展：每工作者問題量與總成本
related.titleEn: Weak scaling: per-worker work and aggregate cost
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付精度分工、兩組修正鏈與停滯診斷；兩δ值相符且更新解滿足原方程；報告明列精確紙面近似；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver precision roles, both refinement chains, and a stagnation diagnosis. Both corrections must match and satisfy the original equation. Identify the exact-arithmetic assumption. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 列P1/16/64各總格數1/16/64百萬，每格物理工作與迭代數不變；.8333/.625正確，局部工作不變且總量隨P成長。
related.differenceEn: List 1, 16, and 64 million total cells with fixed per-cell work, resolution conventions, and iteration counts. Verify both efficiencies, constant local work, and total work growing with P.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 對Ax=b，r=b−Ax、解Aδ=r再更新x+δ；殘差計算精度與修正精度需分欄；合成A3、b1，初值x=.3；另一初值.32，修正方程先以精確紙面算；名義式 (1-3*.3)/3 = 0.0333333333333 correction delta；變更式 (1-3*.32)/3 = 0.0133333333333 correction delta。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

Eweak=Tbaseline/Tscaled，在每工作者工作相同的條件下；總工作與P同比成長；合成每工作者一百萬格，P1時間10秒，P16為12秒、P64為16秒；名義式 10/12 = 0.833333333333 weak-scaling efficiency；變更式 10/16 = 0.625 weak-scaling efficiency。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For Ax = b, form r = b − Ax, solve Aδ = r, and update x + δ. Record residual and correction precisions separately. Synthetic A = 3, b = 1, initial x = 0.3 versus 0.32. Solve the correction exactly on paper. Nominal (1-3*.3)/3 = 0.0333333333333 correction delta; changed (1-3*.32)/3 = 0.0133333333333 correction delta. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Weak efficiency is baseline time divided by scaled time, with constant work per worker and total work proportional to P. Synthetic one million cells per worker: P = 1 takes 10 seconds, P = 16 takes 12, and P = 64 takes 16. Nominal 10/12 = 0.833333333333 weak-scaling efficiency; changed 10/16 = 0.625 weak-scaling efficiency. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
